title: Admissible blow-up
statement:
Let $T$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and $U\subseteq T$ a
quasi-compact open. For a finite-type quasi-coherent ideal
$\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_T$ with $\mathcal I|_U=\mathcal O_U$, the
blow-up

$$
b:\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}(T)=
\operatorname{Proj}_T\Bigl(\bigoplus_{m\geq0}\mathcal I^m\Bigr)
\longrightarrow T
$$

is called *$U$-admissible*. Its center is disjoint from $U$.

lean.note: The sorry-free upstream structure AlgebraicGeometry.IsAdmissible is the exact U-admissible blow-up-center notion: it stores a finite-type quasi-coherent ideal I on X and disjointness of U from I.support, which the source docstring identifies as equivalent to I|_U = O_U; its canonical I.blowup and I.blowupMap give the blow-up and structure morphism in the node statement. Signature and fields were read in WeilConjectures/Blowup/AdmissibleBlowup.lean lines 133-143.
